content:
anna_sales: HealthGrid RFI arrived this morning. They want a 4-week Dedicated POC, capability matrix for embeddings + chat, KMS/HSM detail, and SOC2 evidence. Uploaded: healthgrid_rfi_oct24.pdf. Need a tight draft by COB tomorrow.

jordan_se: Recommend starting with 2x A10 baseline for the POC. Need their target p99 and a sample (PHI-scrubbed) corpus. Who owns perf? @maria_ps

maria_ps: I'll own perf. If they can't provide scrubbed data we will run a synthetic generator with similar token distribution. Please ask for target SLO (suggest p99 <150ms) and max concurrency.

anna_sales: Pricing ask: provisional 4-week POC + conversion to Reserved option. Ballpark to include?

finance_zoe: Provisional stub for RFI: 2x A10 baseline + managed ops ~ $46k for 4 weeks (provisional, subject to finance/legal). Mark clearly as provisional.

sam_security: KMS/HSM note: Hosted supports tenant key separation; HSM-backed keys available on Private deployments via partner integrations (CloudHSM/YubiHSM) and require contract addendum. Will prepare appendix and security questionnaire answers.

jordan_se: Fallback policy example (one-paragraph): "Primary dedicated pool receives traffic; sustained queueing (>85% utilization for 2 minutes or median queue >5s) triggers: 1) route to reserved burst nodes, 2) cross-region dedicated failover if permitted, 3) graceful fallback to a smaller model variant with notification headers and rate-limited responses. Circuit-break thresholds and notification hooks are configurable in the Console."

maria_ps: Capability matrix snippet (for RFI CSV):

```
Feature,Hosted API,Dedicated Pools,Private (VPC/On-prem)
Embeddings,Yes,Yes,Yes
Chat/LLM,Yes,Yes,Yes
Private KMS,No,Yes,Yes
HSM-backed keys,No,Optional add-on,Partner integration reqd
FedRAMP posture,Controls documented,Controls documented,By request + plan
SLA,Standard,Enhanced,Enterprise (negotiable)
Fallback policy,Region spill,Policy-driven,Policy-driven + customer notice
```

anna_sales: Action items: 1) I'll ask HealthGrid for scrubbed sample + SLOs; 2) @maria_ps finalize perf plan; 3) @jordan_se finalize fallback paragraph and provisional wording; 4) @sam_security + finance/legal prepare appendix & provisional pricing caveats; 5) I'll assemble and send draft COB tomorrow. Reviewers: @jordan_se @maria_ps @sam_security @finance_zoe.

doc-bot: Uploaded: healthgrid_rfi_response_draft.pdf -> https://files.redwood.internal/rfi/1768888888/healthgrid_rfi_response_draft.pdf

anna_sales: Please review here. If blockers surface, ping me and I'll escalate.
